description.what_else:
Beste No. 9 is formulated at an ideal, non-stripping pH level of 5.9.

Note from Tiffany Masterson, Drunk Elephant Founder: we took your feedback about the original Beste and made some changes—we swapped out the twist top packaging for a trusty flip top and tweaked the formula so it’s gentle enough to use on eyes (and remove every last trace of makeup).
